name: response-pack
title: Security questionnaire response pack: DRAFT
for_each: select id,code from questionnaires order by code

sections.title: Internal review only
sections.note: Nothing has been sent. Confirm evidence, recipient permission and current answers before handover. Evidence files are not attached.
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,readiness from questionnaire_readiness where id=$1

sections.title: Records
sections.sql: select code,question,answer_text,readiness,evidence_code,evidence_version from response_readiness where questionnaire_id=$1 order by code

name: evidence-register
title: Evidence reference register: INTERNAL
for_each: select id,code from questionnaires order by code

sections.title: Internal review only
sections.note: Nothing has been sent. Confirm evidence, recipient permission and current answers before handover. Evidence files are not attached.
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,readiness from questionnaire_readiness where id=$1

sections.title: Records
sections.sql: select distinct a.evidence_code,a.evidence_version,a.classification,a.readiness from response_readiness a where questionnaire_id=$1 order by a.evidence_code

name: review-request
title: Security answer review request: DRAFT
for_each: select id,code from questionnaires order by code

sections.title: Internal review only
sections.note: Nothing has been sent. Confirm evidence, recipient permission and current answers before handover. Evidence files are not attached.
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,readiness from questionnaire_readiness where id=$1

sections.title: Records
sections.sql: select code,question,owner,readiness from response_readiness where questionnaire_id=$1 and readiness<>'ready' order by code
